summary: Multiple oil tankers were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz within 24 hours, prompting Iranian missile launches at commercial vessels and a 1.4% Brent crude price surge. Explosions rocked Damascus near French President Macron's hotel during his visit. Israeli forces eliminated three senior Hamas commanders in Gaza, including the head of training and a Nukhba unit leader.

sections.executive_summary: Multiple oil tankers were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz within 24 hours, prompting Iranian missile launches at commercial vessels and a 1.4% Brent crude price surge. Explosions rocked Damascus near French President Macron's hotel during his visit. Israeli forces eliminated three senior Hamas commanders in Gaza, including the head of training and a Nukhba unit leader.

points: IRGC launched missiles at two commercial ships near Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday morning, per US official cited by Wall Street Journal, escalating tensions despite reported US-Iran understandings. (Source: @mamlekate/103831)

Ayatollah Khamenei's funeral procession drew millions in Tehran; coffin transported to Qom then Iraq for ceremonies in Najaf (Tuesday evening) and Karbala (Wednesday 6 AM). (Source: @presstv/197422, @presstv/197421, @kianmeli1/88422)

Iraq's top Shia cleric Grand Ayatollah Ali al-Sistani refused to lead funeral prayers over Khamenei's coffin; his son informed Khamenei's office, and representative Javad Shahrestani absent from Tehran ceremonies. (Source: @VahidOnline/76798)
Iran suspended official work in Ilam province bordering Iraq to allow citizens to attend Khamenei funeral processions in Karbala and Najaf. (Source: @naya_foriraq/81367)
Satellite imagery from Reuters showed Tehran funeral crowds numbered only several thousand, contradicting state media claims of millions. (Source: @kianmeli1/88418)
Iranian Defense Ministry stated: 'We continue diplomacy from position of strength but will respond firmly to any aggression or crossing of red lines.' (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/375017)
Weekly 'No to Executions' campaign continued in 57 Iranian prisons for 128th week. (Source: @kianmeli1/88415)

IDF killed Hamas training department commander Fadi Falach Ashour Daghmash in northern Gaza airstrike; he trained Nukhba forces pre-October 7 and managed combat against Israeli forces. (Source: @idf_telegram/24542)

IDF and Shin Bet eliminated Nukhba company commander Ahmed Yahya Ibrahim Batsh in northern Gaza and military intelligence commander Hamouda Abu Daqqa in southern Gaza in separate strikes. (Source: @New_security8200/202255)
Israeli civilians attempted to cross into Syria at Mount Hermon; IDF forces prevented crossing and detained them. (Source: @inon_yttach/9290)
Turkish naval vessels approached Israeli naval exercise area in Mediterranean, disrupting drill and forcing Israeli ships to alter course. (Source: @naya_foriraq/81357)

Unverified claim: Israeli flag raised on Ali Taher hill near Nabatieh, Lebanon, overlooking Imad 4 missile base allegedly besieged by Israel for 20 days with hundreds of militants trapped. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74841)

Trump and Erdogan met in Ankara; Trump called Iran operation 'not war but denuclearization,' praised Turkey's role, pledged to remove CAATSA sanctions blocking F-35 sales. (Source: @VahidOnline/76802, @asafroz/51107)
French far-right leader Marine Le Pen barred from 2027 presidential run after court upholds conviction; unrelated to Middle East conflict. (Source: @asafroz/51102, @amitsegal/62829)

IDF's 8226 Battalion under Paratrooper Brigade discovered old rocket manufacturing workshop in Rafah area, southern Gaza; forces continue scanning for Hamas terror infrastructure, weapons, rockets, and IEDs. (Source: @N12chat/216346)

Three senior Hamas commanders eliminated in 48 hours: training chief Fadi Daghmash (northern Gaza), Nukhba commander Ahmed Batsh (northern Gaza), military intel commander Hamouda Abu Daqqa (southern Gaza). (Source: @idf_telegram/24542, @New_security8200/202255)
Daghmash led Nukhba training pre-October 7, managed combat against IDF in Gaza, recently promoted new terror plots and tried rebuilding Hamas capabilities. (Source: @idf_telegram/24542)

Batsh advanced terror plans against IDF throughout war and recently; Abu Daqqa gathered intelligence on IDF forces for directing terror attacks, posed immediate threat. (Source: @New_security8200/202255)
IDF Southern Command forces deployed per agreement, continue operating to remove immediate threats in Gaza. (Source: @idf_telegram/24542, @New_security8200/202255)

key_developments: IRGC fired missiles at two commercial vessels near Strait of Hormuz Tuesday morning, per US official, marking direct Iranian kinetic action against shipping despite reported de-escalation understandings. (Source: @mamlekate/103831)

Three tankers attacked in Hormuz area within 24 hours; UKMTO confirmed vessel attack with minor damage; Brent crude surged 1.4% to $73/barrel. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/375019, @N12chat/216352, @SharghDaily/170414)

Explosions in Damascus near Macron's hotel during French President's visit; Macron proceeded to meet Syrian President al-Sharaa at presidential palace. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4655, @almogboker78/17660)

IDF eliminated three Hamas commanders in 48 hours: training chief Fadi Daghmash (Nukhba trainer), Nukhba company commander Ahmed Batsh, military intel commander Hamouda Abu Daqqa. (Source: @idf_telegram/24542, @New_security8200/202255)
Turkish naval vessels disrupted Israeli naval exercise in Mediterranean, forcing Israeli ships to change course; incident occurred amid Trump-Erdogan Ankara summit. (Source: @naya_foriraq/81357)

Khamenei funeral processions underway: millions in Tehran per state media, but satellite imagery shows only thousands; coffin now in Iraq for Najaf/Karbala ceremonies; Sistani refuses prayer. (Source: @presstv/197422, @kianmeli1/88418, @VahidOnline/76798)

Trump-Erdogan summit: Trump framed Iran operation as 'denuclearization not war,' praised Turkey, pledged CAATSA sanctions removal for F-35 sales, criticized European NATO allies' lack of support. (Source: @VahidOnline/76802, @asafroz/51107)
sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous escalation in Hormuz — three tanker attacks and IRGC missile launches — indicates Iran is willing to disrupt global energy flows despite diplomatic tracks. The Damascus explosions during Macron's visit signal Syrian theater volatility and potential for miscalculation with foreign leaders present. Israel's targeted decapitation of Hamas's training, Nukhba, and intelligence leadership in Gaza degrades command continuity but may trigger retaliatory rocket fire. Turkish interference with Israeli naval exercises introduces a new NATO-allied friction point. Khamenei's funeral exposes Iranian regime legitimacy questions given low turnout and Sistani's snub, potentially affecting IRGC decision-making.
sections.regional_response: Iraq hosts Khamenei funeral processions in Najaf and Karbala despite Sistani's refusal to participate, balancing Iranian pressure with domestic equities. Turkey leverages Trump-Erdogan summit to advance F-35 sanctions relief while positioning as mediator. Gulf states face direct shipping threats; UKMTO reporting indicates commercial maritime awareness. Yemen's Houthi leadership signals long-term confrontation readiness. European NATO allies face Trump's explicit loyalty test. Jordan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia silent in current messages.
sections.intelligence_notes: Satellite imagery contradicting state media on Tehran funeral attendance suggests Iranian information control challenges. Unverified claim of Israeli flag at Imad 4 missile base in Lebanon, if true, would indicate deep Israeli penetration of Hezbollah strategic assets. Turkish naval disruption of Israeli exercise reveals Ankara's willingness to physically challenge Israeli freedom of navigation. Macron's Damascus visit proceeding post-explosions demonstrates French commitment to Syrian engagement. Greek shipping profits from Russian crude highlight sanctions enforcement gaps. CISA using Anthropic AI for federal vulnerability scanning shows US domestic cyber focus amid regional crisis.
